title: Job Work In (दूसरों के लिए बनाना)
intro:
भाग 8 — Manufacturing & Job Work

कुल Problems: 3 │ 🟢 1 🟡 1 🔴 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

Customer का माल लेकर Job Work करना और Charges पर Invoice।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

Material In (Job Work In)

Manufacturing Journal

Job Work Invoice (सेवा)

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Customer के Stock को अपना Stock मान लेना

Wastage का हिसाब न रखना

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

Godown Masters में 'Our Stock with Third Party'/Job Work Godown के लिए F12 से सही Option Enable करें। Material In/Material Out Voucher Type में 'Use for Job Work = Yes' करें; Manufacture के लिए Stock Journal (Alt+F7) का Manufacturing Mode प्रयोग करें। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Create the Stock Items (with BOM where needed) and Godowns in Tally Prime, pass the Job Work In Order, Material In, Manufacturing and Material Out Vouchers, and verify the Job Work Charges invoice.
guide:
Job Work In (दूसरों के लिए बनाना)

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

ध्यान दें

दरें GST 2.0 (22-Sep-2025 से लागू) के अनुसार हैं। Practice में Question की दी हुई दर ही लगाएँ।

सबसे पहले — Job Work In की तैयारी

  • F11 (Features) → Maintain Inventory, BOM और Enable Job Order Processing = Yes।
  • Godown बनाएँ: "Job Work" (Customer का माल) और ज़रूरत हो तो "Scrap" — दोनों में "Third Party Stock with Us" = Yes।
  • Stock Items और BOM बनाएँ (जहाँ Production हो)।
  • Job Work In Order Voucher में Customer, Finished Item और Qty भरें।
  • Material In: Customer का Raw Material Job Work Godown में आएगा।
  • Manufacturing Voucher (Stock Journal): Raw Material खपत और Finished Goods/Scrap बनाएँ।
  • Material Out: Finished Goods Customer को लौटाएँ।
  • Job Work Charges का Sales/Service Invoice (GST सहित) अलग से बनाएँ।
याद रखें

Raw Material और Finished Goods Customer के हैं — हमारी Books में Stock Value Nil।

हमारी Income सिर्फ़ Job Work Charges है।

Job Work Charges (सेवा) पर GST लगता है; माल लौटाने पर नहीं।

problems.title: Cotton Yarn — Simple Job Work In
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

  • 1st April — Received 200 Kg Raw Cotton from Suresh Textiles for Job Work (Order No. SX-1); expected wastage = 5 Kg, so 195 Kg Cotton Yarn is to be returned
  • 2nd April — Processed and returned 195 Kg Cotton Yarn to Suresh Textiles (Material In → Material Out); charged Job Work Fees ₹ 8,000 + GST 5%
problems.hint:
• 1 Apr: Job Work In Order SX-1 (Suresh Textiles) — 195 Kg Cotton Yarn बनानी है।
  • 1 Apr: Material In — 200 Kg Raw Cotton, Job Work Godown में।
  • 2 Apr: Manufacturing — 200 Kg Cotton → 195 Kg Yarn (5 Kg Wastage)।
  • 2 Apr: Material Out — 195 Kg Cotton Yarn लौटाया।
  • Job Work Fees ₹8,000 + 5% GST का Invoice।

problems.title: Meghraj Mill — Chana Dal to Besan, with Scrap (Expert)
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

1 Bag = 10 Kg। 'Job Work' व 'Scrap' नाम के 2 अलग Godown बनाएँ (Third Party Stock with Us = Yes)। Besan पर GST 5% (CGST 2.5% + SGST 2.5%)।

  • 1st April — Received Job Work In Order (No. HEM-1) from Hemant (Unregistered Dealer, Delhi) for 10 Bags Besan; customer will supply 102 Kg Chana Dal (2 Kg processing wastage/scrap built in) @ ₹50/Kg (material value, supplied free by customer — tracked only)
  • 1st April — Material In: 102 Kg Chana Dal received from Hemant into the 'Job Work' Godown
  • 2nd April — Manufacturing Voucher: 10 Bags Besan produced using the BOM (102 Kg Chana Dal consumed → 100 Kg Besan + 2 Kg Scrap, जो 'Scrap' Godown में गया)
  • 2nd April — Material Out: 10 Bags Besan returned to Hemant; Job Work Charges invoiced @ ₹50/Kg (₹500 per Bag)
problems.hint:
• दो Godown: "Job Work" और "Scrap" (दोनों Third Party Stock with Us = Yes)।
  • 1 bag = 10 Kg। Stock Item "Besan" में Alternate Unit Bag (1 Bag = 10 Kg)।
  • BOM (10 Bags = 100 Kg Besan): Chana Dal 102 Kg → Besan 100 Kg + Scrap 2 Kg (By-product)।
  • 1 Apr: Job Work In Order HEM-1 (Hemant, Unregistered, Delhi) — 10 Bags Besan; Material In: 102 Kg Chana Dal (@ ₹50/Kg मान ₹5,100, सिर्फ़ ट्रैकिंग) Job Work Godown में।
  • 2 Apr: Manufacturing — 102 Kg Chana Dal consumed → 100 Kg Besan + 2 Kg Scrap (Scrap Godown में)।
  • 2 Apr: Material Out — 10 Bags Besan Hemant को; Job Work Charges ₹50/Kg × 100 Kg = ₹5,000 (₹500 प्रति Bag) + 5% GST।
